Lokalny system łączący ludzi, obiekty, d: A local system connecting people, objects, documents and deadlines in one home model. Developed and documented on a self-hosted server.
Jedno lokalne środowisko dla całego domu: One local environment for the whole home.
HomeIntelCore łączy ludzi, obiekty, doku: HomeIntelCore connects people, objects, documents and deadlines in one home model running on a self-hosted server. I am building the project from the Home Memory layer up. Device control, monitoring, energy and local AI are planned as further layers that use the same model.
Informacje o domu są zwykle rozproszone:: Information about a home is usually scattered: an insurance policy in an email, a manual in a folder, an invoice in the cloud and a service date in someone's memory. The goal of the project is to link each piece to the person, vehicle, room or device it concerns.

Interfejs Next.js rozmawia z Core. Core: The Next.js interface talks to Core. Core keeps the object and relation model in PostgreSQL, hands background work to the job queue and reaches documents through DocumentProvider, which connects it to Paperless-ngx.
Kolejne integracje mają dołączać do tego: Further integrations are meant to join the same home model rather than create separate data silos. The same rule applies to Home Assistant, monitoring and energy.
Podstawową jednostką w Core jest obiekt:: The basic unit in Core is an object: a person, home, room, vehicle, pet, device, service or organisation. An object is the reference point for documents, deadlines and relations. That way the system knows what a stored piece of information is about, not just where the file sits.

Serwer HomeIntelCore ma pracować w LAN z: The HomeIntelCore server is meant to run on the LAN behind a MikroTik RB5009 router and a CRS310-8G+2S+IN switch, with its own SFP+ link. The network is still a plan: the cabling has not been installed and segmentation is a concept without defined VLANs.
Podstawowe dane domu, w tym dokumenty, z: Core home data, including documents, stays on a self-hosted server. The internet is meant to extend the system, not to be a precondition for its basic functions.
Asystent i automatyzacja mają korzystać: The assistant and automation are meant to use only information available to the person asking. Automatic actions require prior consent, have explicit limits and leave a record in the history. This model applies to the planned layers, not the current scope.
Usługi domowe nie są wystawiane publiczn: Home services are not exposed publicly. Access from outside the home is meant to be a separate VPN layer, eventually based on WireGuard.
Home Memory is the current scope of work. The remaining stages are planned and have no dates or declared completion level.

Obecny zakres prac i zakres MVP. Cyfrowa: The current scope of work and the MVP scope. A digital memory of the home: an object model with relations, documents with OCR and search, deadlines and reminders. It solves the first real problem and builds the home database the next layers are meant to rely on.
Planowana warstwa sterowania. Home Assis: The planned control layer. Home Assistant is meant to act as the integration engine, with HomeIntelCore providing one app for the home instead of a dozen manufacturer apps. Ordinary home control is meant to remain available without AI.
Planowana warstwa świadomości. Czujniki,: The planned awareness layer. Sensors, cameras and energy data are meant to feed a shared home history, analysed locally wherever possible.
Planowana warstwa rozumienia. Lokalny as: The planned understanding layer. A local assistant is meant to use the relations between data and answer in the context of the home, within the permissions of the person asking. The choice of models and hardware requirements have not been defined yet.
Planowana warstwa działania. Asystent pr: The planned action layer. The assistant proposes routines, learns recurring behaviour and performs previously approved actions within explicit limits. The autonomy levels described below belong to this stage.
Dalsza perspektywa. Kompletne urządzenie: Long term. A complete appliance combining data, integrations, backups and local AI, deployable by a non-technical person as well. Today the system is designed for a self-hosted homelab server. Hardware, performance and distribution remain to be verified.
Osoba, dom, pomieszczenie, pojazd, zwier: A person, home, room, vehicle, pet, device, service or organisation. Fields describe an object's properties, tags organise the collection and relations link objects together.
Dokument mieszkania może być wspólny, a: A document about the flat can be shared, while a household member's private document stays private. The same rules are meant to apply to the planned AI layer.
Data końca ubezpieczenia ma znaczenie w: An insurance end date matters in the context of the vehicle. The deadline and the change history stay with the object instead of disappearing into file names.
Kolejne integracje mają zapisywać inform: Further integrations are meant to store information in the same model so that no separate silos appear for devices, cameras and energy.
HomeIntelCore składa się z własnego Core: HomeIntelCore consists of its own Core and a few specialised services started together with Docker Compose. This page describes the dependencies between them in the current lab and the places where planned integrations are meant to attach. It is not a specification of ports, authentication or access rules.
Core nie przejmuje zadań systemu dokumen: Core does not take over the job of the document system. DocumentProvider is the boundary through which HomeIntelCore uses Paperless-ngx: files, OCR and full-text search stay on the Paperless side, while relations to people, vehicles and devices remain part of the home model.
Oddzielne bazy PostgreSQL podkreślają te: Separate PostgreSQL databases underline this split. A document and an object do not have to be one record to stay connected.
Obiekt nadaje informacjom punkt odniesie: An object gives information a reference point. Instead of separate silos for a car, a person and a device, there is one model in which their relations can be recorded. A Toyota Corolla can have an owner who is a separate object, and the policy, invoices and manual refer to the same vehicle while keeping their own identity as documents.
Import dokumentów, OCR i przypomnienia t: Document import, OCR and reminders go to the job queue instead of blocking the interface. The queue is part of the current lab, and it is started from the same Docker Compose file as the other services.
Pierwsza grupa działa w aktualnym labora: The first group runs in the current lab. The second describes planned integrations that have not been built yet.
„W laboratorium” oznacza usługę uruchomi: "In lab" means a service running in the project's test environment, not a finished, deployed product.
Home Assistant ma pełnić rolę silnika in: Home Assistant is meant to be the integration engine for devices, scenes and routines. Monitoring and energy are meant to deliver events to the shared home history. Local AI is meant to use the relations between data, and WireGuard is meant to be the only way in from outside the LAN. Each of these layers is meant to attach to Core through its own integration boundary, just as documents do through DocumentProvider.

Sieć jest planowana pod pracę HomeIntelC: The network is planned around HomeIntelCore running on the LAN: the server is meant to get its own fast link, and home devices are meant to be separated by role. Below is the physical topology plan and the logical segmentation concept. The cabling has not been installed yet, and VLANs and firewall rules are not defined.
Router MikroTik RB5009 łączy się przez p: The MikroTik RB5009 router connects through a patch panel to the main CRS310-8G+2S+IN switch. The switch has eight 2.5G RJ45 ports and two SFP+ ports, one of which leads to the HomeIntelCore server / NAS.
Segmenty porządkują role urządzeń niezal: Segments organise device roles independently of the cabling. They do not mean a finished VLAN configuration or an implemented access policy, and the split itself does not define the traffic allowed between segments.
Identyfikatory VLAN, podsieci, przypisan: VLAN IDs, subnets, port assignments and firewall rules have not been defined yet.
Plan przewiduje dziewięć zakończeń RJ45: The plan calls for nine RJ45 endings and one SFP+ link to the server. The CRS310-8G+2S+IN has eight RJ45 ports, so one ending must stay a spare or be served by an additional small managed switch. Connecting the router to the switch needs a separate port assignment. Port numbers, SFP+ modules and the uplink medium have not been defined yet.
HomeIntelCore jest projektowany do pracy: HomeIntelCore is designed to run on the LAN. The CRS310 → SFP+ → server link marks the path to services and local data, without claiming unmeasured throughput.
Zdalny dostęp ma być osobną, kontrolowan: Remote access is meant to be a separate, controlled VPN layer, eventually based on WireGuard. Home services are not, and are not meant to be, exposed publicly. The specific configuration and security rules remain part of the deployment.

Warstwa dokumentowa jest obecnym zakrese: The document layer is the current Home Memory scope. A file goes to Paperless-ngx, where it gets OCR and search, and Core links it to an object and a deadline. The example below shows this flow with a car liability policy.
Four components handle this flow. Each has one job and its own place for data.
Przechowuje pliki, wykonuje OCR i udostę: Stores files, runs OCR and provides full-text search in document content. Version 3.0.4 runs in the lab.
Granica, przez którą Core korzysta z Pap: The boundary through which Core uses Paperless-ngx. A document gets linked to a HomeIntelCore object: the policy refers to the vehicle, and the vehicle has a relation to its owner.
Przechowuje model obiektów, relacje i te: Keeps the object model, relations and deadlines. A correctly recorded deadline can be the basis for a reminder.
Core i Paperless-ngx mają osobne bazy. D: Core and Paperless-ngx have separate databases. A document and an object stay connected without being one record.
Laboratorium działa na maszynie M3 i słu: The lab runs on an M3 machine and is used to verify assumptions: import, OCR, performance and the integration boundary with Core. A running lab does not mean a complete product. It is the test environment for the current Home Memory scope.
Odczytanie daty ze skanu nie oznacza jes: Reading a date from a scan does not yet mean it is the insurance end date. The document type, the object and the deadline need to be described correctly. The project does not assume every PDF will be interpreted automatically without errors.
Documents stay on a self-hosted server. HomeIntelCore adds the home model to them: people, vehicles, devices and relations that give files meaning. An invoice can refer at once to the home, a room, a device, a purchase and a warranty.
Sterowanie, świadomość i lokalne AI pozo: Control, awareness and local AI remain later roadmap stages, not part of the current document layer.
The project grows from the home memory layer. The next stages are meant to use the same object model instead of building their own data silos. The roadmap describes direction, without release dates and without a declared completion level.
